Row.Text: The Altar receives a +1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness Adjacency for Mountains and Natural Wonders.
+1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture on [icon:CITY_UNIQUE_QUARTER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTRICT_TOOLTIP]Quarters[/TIP] in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] with an Altar.
+5 [icon:Action_Heal] Healing for Units in Rural tiles with an Altar in the [icon:NOTIFICATION_SELECT_CAPITAL] Capital.

+1 [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food on Farms, Pastures, and Plantations in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] with an Altar. [icon:YIELD_WAREHOUSE] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WAREHOUSE_TOOLTIP]Warehouse[/TIP] bonus.

+1 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold on Camps and Woodcutters in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] with an Altar. [icon:YIELD_WAREHOUSE] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WAREHOUSE_TOOLTIP]Warehouse[/TIP] bonus.

+10% [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production towards constructing [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Buildings[/TIP] in [icon:YIELD_CITIES] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CITIES_TOOLTIP]Cities[/TIP] with an Altar.

+1 [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production on Fishing Boats in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] with an Altar. [icon:YIELD_WAREHOUSE] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WAREHOUSE_TOOLTIP]Warehouse[/TIP] bonus.
+1[icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture,[icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food,[icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold,[icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness,[icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production, and[icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science on the Altar.

+15% [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production towards training [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MILITARY_UNIT_TOOLTIP]Military Units[/TIP] in [icon:YIELD_CITIES] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CITIES_TOOLTIP]Cities[/TIP] with an Altar.
+1 [icon:YIELD_SCIENCE] Science on [icon:CITY_UNIQUE_QUARTER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTRICT_TOOLTIP]Quarters[/TIP] in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] with an Altar.

+10% [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production towards constructing [icon:WONDER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WONDERS_TOOLTIP]Wonders[/TIP] in [icon:YIELD_CITIES] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CITIES_TOOLTIP]Cities[/TIP] with an Altar. This Pantheon can be chosen by multiple Civilizations.
+10% [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production towards training [icon:UNIT_SETTLER] Settlers in [icon:YIELD_CITIES] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CITIES_TOOLTIP]Cities[/TIP] with an Altar.

The Altar receives a +1[icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness Adjacency for Coast, Lakes, and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_NAVIGABLE_RIVER_TOOLTIP]Navigable River[/TIP] tiles. This Pantheon can be chosen by multiple Civilizations.

+1 [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production on Clay Pits, Mines, and Quarries in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] with an Altar. [icon:YIELD_WAREHOUSE] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_WAREHOUSE_TOOLTIP]Warehouse[/TIP] bonus.

+1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness on [icon:RADIAL_RESOURCES] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_RESOURCES_TOOLTIP]Resources[/TIP] in [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP] with an Altar. This Pantheon can be chosen by multiple Civilizations.

+25% [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence towards [icon:ENDEAVOR] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ENDEAVOR_TOOLTIP]Endeavors[/TIP] and [icon:SANCTIONS] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SANCTION_TOOLTIP]Sanctions[/TIP] with an Altar in the [icon:NOTIFICATION_SELECT_CAPITAL] Capital. This Pantheon can be chosen by multiple Civilizations.
